title: Titanyum and More
description: This mod adds a mineral called Titanyum to your game, which allows you to make weapons, armor and many more things. This mod is only suitable for force.
body:
#📖**What is this mode?**

_Are you bored of the game? Do you want new things? This mod is for you, thanks to this mod you can find a new mine and a lot of things can be done with this mine._

##⭐**What does this mod include?** 

_This mod introduces a metal called Titanium, with which you can make weapons, tools, armor and a block._

**_Blocks_**

![Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/819997ef3d6f5e35b4c9751814b53913887ec03f.png)

**_Weapons and Armor_**

![Weapons and Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8edc0ee1b2c7e5b4b24fc224405203c04f8c4f5a.png)

**_Tools and Items_**

![Tools and Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21d30ad2391fb51d11d330c1dedf4f01c711fc8f.png)

###👍**Finally**

_Finally, thank you for downloading this mod and have a good game._

###⬇️**_Download and Installation_**

If you are asking how to install this mod, here is the answer.

1.**Download the mode from here**

2.**Download and install Forge 1.20.1**

3.**After installing Forge 1.20.1, put this mod in the mods folder.**

4.**And that's it, all that's left is to enter Minecraft and create a world.**
